name: Velvet Bailiff
lore: A patient tortoise who rearranges a fight rather than racing through it. Thread slows, flowing traffic gates and a clearly warned quiet court reward careful placement.

primary.name: Velvet Thread
primary.description: A thread dart deals 15 and slows by 40% for 1.2s.

secondary.name: Traffic Order
secondary.description: An aimed 145-radius order lasts 3s. Slow enemies by 45% and gently move them sideways along the marked gates. No damage.

special.name: Quiet Court
special.description: After a visible 0.8s warning, a 150-radius court deals 28 and stuns foes for 1.8s. Walls block its effect.

passive: Due Process: Casting Traffic Order grants you 20% damage reduction for 2s.

technique.name: Inward Order

attack.name: Inward Order
attack.description: Pull affected foes gently toward the centre instead of sideways; retain the slow for 3s.

technique.description: Trade sideways flow for a central pull and longer cooldown.

final_technique.name: Twin Threads

attack.name: Twin Threads
attack.description: Two narrow 9-damage threads. Each applies the normal slow; less focused damage and slower recovery.

final_technique.description: Replace one thread with two weaker threads in a narrow fan.
